messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: deploy-health-alert for service=redwood-runtime region=eu-west-1. error_rate spike > 5% over 5m, auto-safety-gate engaged.
leah: oncall here, reading. did the canary traffic shift complete?
maya: partial — control-plane reports 60% to model-v2 canary, 40% to stable. error rates rising specifically on model-v2 instances.
samir: logs show OOMs + KV cache eviction spikes on the newest kernel build. reproducing locally on a small pod w/ sequence_len=2048.
leah: ok engage fallback plan A: flip safety gate to stop new rollouts and remove model_v2 from routing. can someone prep the flag toggle?
nina: reaching out to support to surface to impacted accounts in EU region, small subset of customers hitting generation failures. collecting session IDs.
zack: i'll run the flag toggle. command: 
```
# disable model v2 in routing
redwoodctl feature-flag set model_v2_enabled false --env=prod --region=eu-west-1 --reason="safety-gate auto-engaged"
```
deploy-bot: executed toggle request accepted, rollout to edge proxies queued (job id: j-349820).
leah: start gradual drain from model_v2 nodes, target 1m drain windows. verify tracing.
maya: starting drain now. attaching sample trace ids: trace: 0a3c... , 4f2b... forwarding to samir for kernel logs.
samir: confirmed KV cache thrash during heavy prefix reuse. manual rollback of runtime kernel has lower risk than continuing canary. recommend pinning stable model and forcing traffic back.
leah: agreed. samir, initiate manual rollback to model_v1 for eu-west-1 only. keep canary in other regions paused.
samir: initiating rollback: 
```
redwoodctl rollout set model=redwood-model-v1 --region=eu-west-1 --strategy=immediate --drain-wait=60
```
deploy-bot: rollback job j-349821 created, estimated completion 90s.
leah: @nina please confirm support message with affected customer list and proposed ETA.
nina: drafted message to EU accounts affected: "We're reverting a recent model update in EU region to restore stability. No action required from you; you may see transient failed requests for ~5 mins. We'll follow up if we need logs." sending now.
zack: rollback job succeeded. traffic shifted back to model_v1.
maya: smoke checks: generation test suite passing 100/100 in eu-west-1. latency back to baseline.
samir: kernel-level metrics stabilized; KV cache hit-rate restored. no OOMs observed.
leah: great. please run post-mortem checklist: collect timeline, reasons (kernel change + sequence distribution mismatch), and remediation. assign owner for rollback automation gap.
maya: grabbing timeline and logs, will post to incidents channel and link to ticket.
nina: support notified customers; no escalations so far.
leah: oncall handoff in 30m, i'll keep monitoring for 15. thanks all. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident resolved: safety-gate fallback + manual rollback completed. severity: P1 -> P2. link: https://internal.redwood/incident/INC-2026-1843
